verdict.rationale: This is routine Microsoft Office Click-to-Run servicing: OfficeClickToRun.exe running as SYSTEM launches its own signed Integrator.exe with expected package arguments from the Office install path. The full-access handle (0x001fffff) to a child process it spawned is typical of this updater and does not indicate injection or credential access.
